title: eriobotrya deflexa f. buisanensis
intro: Eriobotrya deflexa f. buisanensis, commonly known as the Buisan pear or Chinese quince, is a species of flowering plant in the rose family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties that may aid in the treatment of various conditions such as digestive issues, respiratory problems, and skin irritations. The therapeutic actions of Eriobotrya deflexa f. buisanensis are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities. However, more research is needed to confirm its effectiveness and potential interactions with medications.
